channel.title: Kludy Ramirez — Blog
channel.description: Notes on AI, automation, and building systems that just work.

item.title: Least privilege is a moving target
item.description: Half my recent board was access requests: grant this role, scope that one, take another away. The ticket that reframed it asked me to move everyone to read-only except the one person still collecting payments.

item.title: Before you migrate the software, migrate the knowledge
item.description: We are replacing Akia, the AI messaging tool our guest hosts live in. The hardest ticket was not code. It was writing down how the team actually works.

item.title: The week SEO became AEO
item.description: People are asking AI about us instead of Googling us. One ClickUp ticket revealed our FAQ schema was invisible to AI crawlers. Fixing it took a schema rewrite and an MCP audit of every script on the site.

item.title: The bugs that never throw errors
item.description: Before BoltOS went live I audited staging and filed every finding as a ticket. The two that stuck with me never raised an exception. One skipped a day of pricing. One quoted a guest in pesos.

item.title: One tech team, three companies
item.description: My tickets come from three ClickUp spaces: Tech Co, Brand Co, and Ops Co. Same laptop, three different jobs. A resort turns out to be a complete tech education.

item.title: Taking BoltOS live, one ticket at a time
item.description: We moved our in-house PMS from staging to production this month. The milestone wasn't the migration itself. It was the hundred small tickets that turned a working system into one a real team could trust.

item.title: How I use Claude Code to automate the boring 80%
item.description: A practical look at the agentic workflows I run daily — CRM audits, data migrations, pixel debugging — and where AI genuinely saves time (and where it still doesn't).
